title: Battle of Mogadishu
summary: US special forces raiding Mogadishu to capture aides of warlord Mohamed Farrah Aidid lost two Black Hawk helicopters, and 18 Americans and hundreds of Somalis died.
reason: The UN mission in Somalia had turned to hunting Aidid after his militia attacked peacekeepers.
significance: It made the US wary of intervening in Africa, which shaped its inaction in Rwanda.
